name: Guild Issue Sword
flavor: Free with registration. You get what you pay for.

name: Hollis's Practice Blade
flavor: Bent from a thousand swings. Still true.

name: Grukk's Cleaver
flavor: He named it "Hungry." It was.

name: Guild Rookie Hood
flavor: Brown leather, a little too big. Everyone's first hood.

name: Minor Healing Potion
flavor: Tastes like mint and regret.

name: Silver Wolf Pelt
flavor: It still glows faintly under the moon.

name: Moonfang Dagger
flavor: One fang for revenge, one for mercy.

name: Oak Guild Card
flavor: Rank F. Burned stamp. Your name, spelled almost right.

name: Healing Herb
flavor: Smells like mint. Fennick will tell you if you picked the wrong one.

name: Mina's Silver Earring
flavor: A gift from her sister. She'll pretend it's not important.

name: Rookie's Pouch
flavor: Holds three potions and a lot of hope.

name: Copper Compass
flavor: Points to the nearest unfinished promise.

name: Fire Bomb
flavor: Throw it at something you don't like. Ring 0's Firestorm starter.

name: Mandrake Root
flavor: Still screaming, very quietly.

name: Guild Issue Mace & Buckler
flavor: Heavy enough to matter, light enough to lift all day.

name: Guild Issue Staff
flavor: The crystal is glass. The intent is real.

name: Guild Issue Censer
flavor: Smells of cheap incense and good intentions.

name: Guild Issue Daggers
flavor: A matched pair. Mostly matched.

name: Guild Issue Shortbow
flavor: The string is new. The bow remembers other hands.

name: Guild Issue Whip
flavor: Mostly for making a noise. Monsters respect a good noise.

name: Guild Issue Smithing Hammer
flavor: Drives nails. Also goblins.

name: Guild Issue Spear
flavor: Long enough to keep a goblin honest.

name: Guild Issue Hand Wraps
flavor: Cloth, tape and a strong suggestion.

name: Guild Issue Lute
flavor: Three strings in tune. The fourth has opinions.

name: Unmarked Grimoire
flavor: The guild sells it without asking what you will write in it.

name: Fangblade
flavor: A goblin blade, re-edged with wolf fangs along the spine.

name: Carapace Cap
flavor: Beetle plates riveted to a fur lining. Smells like a forest floor.

name: Talon Charm
flavor: Crow talons bound with feather and a sliver of core. Lucky, they say.

name: Hunter's Skewer
flavor: Prime meat, campfire-charred. The best meal in Whisperwood is the one you cooked yourself.

name: Ironbound Mace
flavor: Crude iron bands around a boar tusk. It settles arguments.

name: Bronze Greaves
flavor: Labyrinth bronze, beaten thin enough to walk in.

name: Cursed Iron Blade
flavor: The iron hums when the lanterns go out. Brannoc says that is only the cooling.

name: Mythic Horn Lance
flavor: A single horn, drawn out and set on a long shaft. It is lighter than it has any right to be.

name: Pearl Band
flavor: A river pearl in a plain band. Warm when someone is thinking of you.

name: Fanged Amulet
flavor: Three fangs and a tusk chip on a leather cord. Plain, sturdy, a little proud.

name: Temple Gold Signet
flavor: Temple gold rolled into a ring. It carries a faint memory of bells.

name: Healing Potion
flavor: Fennick keeps the second batch for people who promise to come back.

name: Greater Healing Potion
flavor: Deep green and slow to pour. It smells of a whole meadow.

name: Leather Cap
flavor: Stitched in the tannery shed by someone who wanted you home for supper.

name: Hunter Jerkin
flavor: Pelt and a fang for luck. It remembers the forest.

name: Giant Hide Boots
flavor: Thick enough for stones, soft enough for a long road.

name: Shadehide Cloak
flavor: Cursed fur, calmed with shade essence. It only looks like it is watching you.

name: Serpent Scale Jerkin
flavor: Overlapping scales over horsehair padding. It flexes like a held breath.

name: Silk Hood
flavor: Light, close-fitting and surprisingly warm.

name: Apprentice Robe
flavor: Ines tucks a scrap of spirit paper into the hem. For luck, she says.

name: Inkwell Dye
flavor: Deep blue-black, and a little goes a long way. A cosmetic dye for any outfit.

name: Nightveil Hood
flavor: Silk with a night shard woven in. Evenings feel kinder under it.

name: Hexwarden Robe
flavor: Cursed fur lined with silk, tamed and quiet. It keeps odd draughts off.

name: Mushroom Skewer
flavor: Spore caps and a leaf of healing herb over the coals. Earthy and kind.

name: Tail Roast
flavor: Slow-roasted until the edges crackle. Best eaten while still too hot.

name: Hearth Stew
flavor: Marta ladle, Marta pot, and a seat by the fire.

name: Hearth Loaf
flavor: Crusty, golden and still warm. Hugo swears the oven does half the work.

name: Tuskroast Platter
flavor: A proper sit-down meal. Someone always asks for seconds.

name: Hearth Ale
flavor: Golden, mild and made in the cellar under the Sleeping Griffon.

name: Brimstone Bitters
flavor: A pinch of brimstone for a warm chest and a bright mind. Sip slowly.

name: Ember Rune
flavor: A Khazdur glyph for heat, cut small enough to hold in a palm.

name: Tide Rune
flavor: Cool to the touch even beside a forge.

name: Stone Rune
flavor: Heavy for its size. Dwarves say it remembers being a mountain.

name: Anvil Rune
flavor: The first glyph an apprentice learns to strike.

name: Hearth Rune
flavor: Warm, and faintly smells of bread.

name: Gale Rune
flavor: It hums when the wind turns.

name: Scroll of Emberbrand
flavor: Ink that glows like a banked coal.

name: Scroll of Wardweave
flavor: A tight knot of lines, meant to be worn, not read.

name: Scroll of Vitality
flavor: Smells of crushed herbs.

name: Scroll of Nightstep
flavor: The ink only shows in shadow.

name: Scroll of Stormthread
flavor: The paper tingles when you hold it.

name: Scrap Blade
flavor: A blade blank hammered out of salvage.

name: Iron Blade
flavor: Clean steel, waiting for a hilt.

name: Pelt-Wrapped Hilt
flavor: Wolf pelt, wound tight and stitched.

name: Fang-Capped Hilt
flavor: A hilt with a fang for a pommel.

name: Tempered Shortsword
flavor: Two good parts, fitted by someone who cared.

name: Ironwrought Longsword
flavor: Balanced on the finger, the way Torvald checks them.

name: Healing Herb Seeds
flavor: Tiny and dry. Plant them in good dirt and be patient.

name: Wheat Seeds
flavor: A pinch of gold in a paper twist.

name: Turnip Seeds
flavor: The easiest thing in the world to grow.

name: Mandrake Seeds
flavor: Plant them gently. The mandrake grumbles in its sleep.

name: Wheat Sheaf
flavor: Heavy heads, sweet smell.

name: Turnip
flavor: Round, pale, honest.

name: Turnip Mash
flavor: Butter helps. Salt helps more.

name: Garden Stew
flavor: Everything in it came from your own dirt.

name: Harvest Ale
flavor: Wheat, patience and a barrel.

name: Covenant tablet, upper half
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Covenant tablet, lower half
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Foundation plate, left edge
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Foundation plate, right edge
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Seed-bowl rim
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Seed-bowl base
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Primer leaf, first page
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Primer leaf, second page
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Primer leaf, binding
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Humming glass shard
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.

name: Humming glass rim
flavor: A broken piece of something old. Perhaps it fits with another.
